study_region: Sylhet Division, Bangladesh (Haor Basin / SWOT overpass region)

prcptot.description: Apr-May total precipitation on wet days (P ≥ 1 mm/day), mm

r50mm.description: Count of Apr-May heavy-rain days (P ≥ 50 mm/day), days

spatial_coverage_policy.zone_membership: half-open intervals on cell centres; no cell can belong to two zones
spatial_coverage_policy.weighting: cos(latitude) area weights applied after cell-first accumulation

statistical_methods.slope_ci: Gilbert (1987) rank bounds at 95% using Var*(S)
statistical_methods.trend_test: Mann-Kendall with Hamed-Rao (1998) multi-lag rank autocorrelation correction
statistical_methods.autocorrelation_basis: Ranks of detrended residuals; consecutive calendar-year pairs for lag estimation

minimum_seasons_basis: Predeclared project threshold; not a WMO guideline
data_completeness_policy: A season is complete when all 61 Apr-May days are present (no duplicates) and each day has ≥95% valid cells. Incomplete seasons are retained in annual_series with season_complete=false.
limitations: Area-weighted zone indicators do not establish causality or predict individual floods. Spatial dependence across zones and multiple-area inference require explicit extension. Source authenticity depends on the retrieval record and reviewable provenance; SHA-256 verifies file integrity only.

prcptot.slope_ci_note: Confidence interval for the Sen slope estimate; not a per-year uncertainty band.
prcptot.significance_note: is_significant refers to p_value_adjusted at α=0.05; Holm-Bonferroni applied across 6 tests (3 zones × 2 indicators).
